mentions.name: WhyNotLog
mentions.description: This web app lets users log personal data and apply statistics to answer tricky questions, such as what triggers their dog's allergies or what affects their sleep.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building WhyNotLog to answer tricky questions using statistics. Example questions include "what gives my dog allergies?" or "what affects my sleep?".
